name: Sawaki Setsuko
source:
A mature wife who seduces Issei with her mysterious and bewitching smile.

She is actually Aiko's mother. She sometimes watches Issei from the shadows as he visits the Sawaki family.

[From [Url=http://13cm.jp/game/shimai2/index.html]official site[/url]]
